title: eriastrum densifolium subsp. elongatum
intro: Eriastrum densifolium subsp. elongatum, commonly known as the Elongated Woolly Bells, is a plant species in the phlox family (Polemoniaceae). The Elongated Woolly Bells is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Eriastrum densifolium subsp. elongatum include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
